SURAT__LUCKNOW.headline: Why Curve 5G (₹17,999) sells 1,385 units in Surat vs. only 310 in Lucknow—while Power 5G (₹11,499) sells 1,490 in Lucknow
SURAT__LUCKNOW.summaryPlain: Lucknow isn't rejecting ₹18,000 phones—3 operational gaps at the distributor and shop counter are blocking Curve 5G sales while leaving ₹11.5k Power 5G unaffected.

factors.title: Top-Selling Black 256GB Variant Out of Stock for 11 Days
factors.evidence: Obsidian Black 8GB/256GB drives 62% of Curve 5G sales nationally. Lucknow distributor (Awadh Telelink) has 0 Black units left (only 42 Blue 128GB), while Kanpur depot (82 km away) has 580 Black units sitting idle.
factors.fixAction: Move 350 units of Curve 5G Black 256GB from Kanpur depot to Lucknow within 24 hours.

factors.title: Rival Brand Paying Shopkeepers ₹411 More Per Phone This Week
factors.evidence: Since Nov 6, rival brand added a ₹400 cash payout in Hazratganj & Alambagh, taking rival shop margin to ₹1,580 vs Zenith's ₹1,169 base margin (where shops haven't unlocked Gold Slab yet).
factors.fixAction: Trigger WhatsApp Slab-Target Nudge (+₹350/unit Gold Slab + ₹150 weekend booster) to 142 Lucknow shops within 4 units of target.

factors.title: 0% EMI Counter Mapping Missing in 71% of Lucknow Shops
factors.evidence: 64% of ₹18,000 phones in India sell on EMI. In Surat, 78% of shops have Bajaj/TVS 0-down EMI active on Curve 5G; in Lucknow only 29% do—forcing cash buyers down to the ₹11,499 Power 5G.
factors.fixAction: Send 1-click Bajaj/TVS dealer SKU activation link + ₹999/mo EMI counter standee to 210 Lucknow shops.

factors.title: Genuine Local Demand for 6000mAh Battery Among Field/Delivery Buyers
factors.evidence: Lucknow has a 2.1x larger gig-delivery & field-staff buyer base who genuinely prefer Power 5G's 6000mAh flat-screen build—keep stocking Power 5G strongly alongside fixing Curve 5G.
factors.fixAction: Maintain 1,600+/mo Power 5G supply in Lucknow—do not cut Power 5G to fund Curve 5G.

JAIPUR__PATNA.headline: Why Curve 5G sells 1,190 units in Jaipur vs. 245 in Patna—while Patna sells 2,800 units of Power 5G & Go 4G
JAIPUR__PATNA.summaryPlain: In Patna, shopkeepers stopped pushing Curve 5G after a 6-day curved screen spare-part delay last month, compounded by distributor credit limits.

factors.title: Distributor Credit Cap Forced Cheaper SKU Ordering
factors.evidence: Magadh Distributors hit its ₹1.2 Cr credit cap on Nov 8 and used remaining limit to buy 3x volume of ₹6,799 Go 4G & ₹11,499 Power 5G instead of ₹17,999 Curve 5G.
factors.fixAction: Approve 14-day consignment/credit top-up of ₹28 Lakhs specifically ring-fenced for Curve 5G 256GB.

factors.title: 6-Day Service Wait on Curved Screens Hurt Shopkeeper Confidence
factors.evidence: Patna service center ran out of curved AMOLED spares in Oct (5.8-day wait vs 1.3 days in Jaipur). Customers complained back at Boring Road shops, so dealers switched to pitching flat-screen phones.
factors.fixAction: Pre-stock 45 curved display kits at Patna center & broadcast '24-Hr Home Replacement Active' assurance on dealer WhatsApp.

factors.title: Low Paperless EMI Coverage (24% vs 74% in Jaipur)
factors.evidence: 76% of Patna transactions are cash/UPI, naturally favoring sub-₹12k phones unless TVS Credit / Bajaj zero-down-payment desks are active.
factors.fixAction: Enable paperless NBFC QR EMI & ₹1,000 old-phone exchange bonus in top 85 Patna stores.

SURAT__INDORE.headline: Hidden Growth Opportunity: Indore has the exact buyer & EMI profile of Surat, but runs out of Curve 5G stock every 18 days
SURAT__INDORE.summaryPlain: Indore activates 96% of every Curve 5G unit billed (498/520) and already has 68% EMI shop coverage—it is simply under-allocated by 550+ units/month.

factors.title: Severe Under-Allocation (Only 4 Black 256GB Units Left in City)
factors.evidence: Malwa Mobility Links sold through 96% of Curve 5G stock by Nov 15. Stores in Vijay Nagar & Rajwada are turning away buyers.
factors.fixAction: Re-route 320 units from Bhopal/Ahmedabad buffer stock + raise Indore weekly forecast by +65%.

factors.title: In-Store Promoter Count is 1/3rd of Surat (22 vs 65)
factors.evidence: Stores in Indore with promoters sell 14 Curve 5G/month vs 3.8/month in non-promoter stores.
factors.fixAction: Deploy WhatsApp Counter Sales Helper & ₹350 Gold Slab nudge across 120 high-footfall Indore stores.

warrantyCases.issueReported: 5G network keeps dropping to 4G inside home / shop
steps: Customer sent WhatsApp voice note: 'Mera naya Power 5G ghar ke andar baar-baar 4G pe chala jata hai, phone badalwana hai.'
AI Helper checked IMEI signal log & guided user with 2 screenshots: Settings → Network → Turn OFF 'Smart 5G Battery Saver' & set Preferred Network to '5G NR Auto'.
Customer confirmed steady 5G icon & 240 Mbps speed test in 3 minutes. Avoided unnecessary technician home visit (₹650) & replacement claim!

warrantyCases.issueReported: USB-C fast charging disconnects unless cable is held at an angle
steps: AI Helper asked user to test with another USB-C cable and share a 5-second video — port remained loose.
Verified IMEI #864921059912771 belongs to Noida Factory Batch #N08-OctW3 (known sub-board solder alert).
Checked Kongu Service Center inventory (14 replacement units & sub-boards in stock) and booked Technician Rajesh K. for Tomorrow 11:00 AM at customer's home.

warrantyCases.issueReported: Phone feels warm during first 30 mins after software update
steps: Customer messaged asking for doorstep replacement after Android 15 security update made phone warm.
AI Helper checked background app indexing status, guided user to pause background photo backup on mobile data & restart once.
Battery temperature dropped from 41°C to 34°C within 15 minutes; customer rated 5/5 on WhatsApp.
